correctness.rationale: For q at least two, group-rotation minimization gives the quotient cosine law with folded azimuth uniformly distributed over [0,pi/q]. Because its cosine is nonnegative, the event D>pi-epsilon forces opposite polar caps of radius epsilon. The normalized area factor is 1/2 after summing the two cap orientations. Scaling, dominated convergence and the analytic integral I(psi)=(sin psi-psi cos psi)/(8 sin^3 psi) yield C_q exactly. Strict growth of I in psi gives strict decrease of C_q with q; q=1 is the standard smooth-sphere quadratic law. Reproducible scripts compare 1600 group-orbit distances and 16 finite-epsilon quadratures and are corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
